question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier. Over 2025-12-08 (UTC window 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-09T00:00:00Z), DemoBooth_NVIDIA averaged 15.515 head_count vs 10.648333333333333 at DemoBooth_Intel (camera_location), a ratio of 1.46 (NVIDIA-to-Intel).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.camera_location IN ['DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel']
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z'
  AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH ch.camera_location AS location, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS hc_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS samples
WITH location, CASE WHEN samples > 0 THEN toFloat(hc_sum) / samples ELSE 0.0 END AS avg_hc
WITH
  max(CASE WHEN location = 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA' THEN avg_hc END) AS nvidia_avg_hc,
  max(CASE WHEN location = 'DemoBooth_Intel' THEN avg_hc END) AS intel_avg_hc
RETURN
  CASE WHEN coalesce(nvidia_avg_hc, 0) >= coalesce(intel_avg_hc, 0) THEN 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA' ELSE 'DemoBooth_Intel' END AS busier_location,
  nvidia_avg_hc,
  intel_avg_hc,
  CASE WHEN intel_avg_hc IS NULL OR intel_avg_hc = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round((nvidia_avg_hc / intel_avg_hc) * 100.0) / 100.0 END AS ratio_nvidia_to_intel,
  CASE WHEN nvidia_avg_hc IS NULL OR nvidia_avg_hc = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round((intel_avg_hc / nvidia_avg_hc) * 100.0) / 100.0 END AS ratio_intel_to_nvidia,
  '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AS window_start_utc,
  '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AS window_end_utc
